title: Part Seven: Education: The Credential and the Debt

sections.brief: K-12 revenue FY2024 (state 45.2/local 43.2/federal 11.6; property tax 63.3% of local, about 27% of all; $11,060-$31,918 per pupil); property-tax funding as designed friction; FHA 1938 school clause; San Antonio v. Rodriguez (21 March 1973, 5-4; Edgewood $356 vs Alamo Heights $594); state-court aftermath; Ed Trust 2018, EdBuild 2019 and Urban 2017 gap measures and why they differ; Jackson-Johnson-Persico; NAEP/PISA spread; where state aid works. Figures: flow; compare

Real published in-state tuition $5,940 (1995-96) to $13,150 peak (2019-21) to $11,950 (2025-26); the circulating '+1,200%' figure; net tuition $4,450 to $2,300; SHEF state support; Pell share 72-77% (late 1970s) to 28.6% (2025-26) with purchasing power flat; OBBBA Pell rule; for-profit colleges and defaults (Looney-Yannelis); degree inflation (Fuller 2017, 2024); wage premium as counter-evidence (CEW 75%). Figures: time; compare (told vs record for the part)

Totals ($1.65tn NY Fed; 42.3m borrowers; 9.3m in default owing $234bn); bankruptcy law step by step 1973-2005 with public laws, the '<1%' figure and its source, Brunner; Sallie Mae lobbying record vs what the record does not show; collection without a court; status as of 22 Oct 2026 (collections paused 16 Jan 2026, no restart date; SAVE ended; RAP launched); 2022 DOJ process and 98% result; labelled interpretation with counter-readings.
